To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effect of GCs (DEX) on the hypothalamic expression level of appetite-related genes (NPY, AgRP and CrH) is dependent on dietary energy level, feeding state and their interactions.
DEX injection increased the mRNA expression of hypothalamic appetite-related peptides in a diet- and feeding-state-dependent manner.

DEX injection increased hypothalamic expression level of CRH and GC receptors mRNA under fasting conditions, but decreased the hypothalamic expression genes of NPY and AgRP mRNA under re-feeding condition.

the regulation mechanism of appetite by GCs in chickens under different energy levels and feeding conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the study of the appetite control of GCs.
